entities.name: Stanisław Grzmot-Skotnicki

entities.summary: Stanisław Grzmot-Skotnicki was a Polish military commander and a general of the Polish Army. During the invasion of Poland of 1939 he commanded the Czersk Operational Group and was among the highest ranking Polish officers to be killed in action in that war.

entities.summary: Stanisław Grzmot-Skotnicki was a Polish military commander and a general of the Polish Army. During the invasion of Poland of 1939 he commanded the Czersk Operational Group and was among the highest ranking Polish officers to be killed in action in that war.
